the electrical properties of Al2O3-based MIS-structures for GaN-based devices.
the electrical properties of MIS-structures and MIS-HEMT devices with ALD-Al2 O3 deposited by using H2O and/or O3 as the O-source.

the use of both H2O + and O3-based AlO3 as a gate insulator is the best choice for GaN-based devices.
the use of both H2O +O3 as the oxygen precursor in the ALD process is beneficial for improving the electrical properties of the Al2O 3 layer and MIS-HEMT structures.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of H2O +O3 as the oxygen precursor for the ALD-Al 2O3 results in a decrease of the fixed charge in Al2O3 and a suppression of the drain leakage current.
the H2O and/or O3-based ALD-Al2 O3 is a promising insulator for MIS-GaN-based devices.
using H2O and ozone as the ALD-oxygen precursors is a promising approach to obtain an Al2O3 insulator for GaN-based electronic devices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MIS-HEMT devices with ALD-Al2 3 deposited by using both H 2O and O 3 as oxygen precursors are promising candidates for high-power and high-temperature electronic devices.
the ALD-AlD-Al2O 3 deposited by using both H2 O and O3 as oxygen precursors is suitable for GaN-based devices.
